structure.unit: Amendment of Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws

law.catch_line: Amendment of bylaws by board of directors or shareholders

text.section: A corporation's shareholders may amend or repeal the corporation's bylaws.

A corporation's board of directors may amend or repeal the corporation's bylaws except to the extent that:
The articles of incorporation or § 13.1-715 reserves that power exclusively to the shareholders; or
Except as provided in subsection E of § 13.1-624, the shareholders in amending, repealing, or adopting a bylaw expressly provide that the board of directors may not amend, repeal, or reinstate that bylaw.
A shareholder of the corporation does not have a vested property right resulting from any provision in the bylaws.
